messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected in eu-west-1 gateway cluster. 5m error rate 18% (threshold 2%). Paging on-call.
priya (eng-oncall): ack. I'm pulling the gateway dashboards now. +1 on-call.
jon (sre): I see increased 502/504 from router -> inference-proxy pool. Latency also spiked. Correlating with recent routing rule push around 09:10 UTC.
priya (eng-oncall): rolling up logs: `kubectl logs -l app=gateway -n prod --since=15m | grep "502" | head -n 50`
priya (eng-oncall): can someone check if a canary rollout went out to eu-west1 around that time? @mk-deploy-bot any deploy events?
mk-deploy-bot: deploy event: service=gateway, env=prod, region=eu-west-1, user=automated-rollout, id=deploy-20250412-0910, status=SUCCESS
luca (sre): thanks. Looks like new gateway image is in eu-west pools only. I'm checking upstreams. Could be a protocol mismatch with inference-proxy v2.
jon (sre): quick mitigation idea: shift traffic off eu-west1 to eu-central-1 and us-east-1 for affected routes. Can we open a temporary traffic-steer? @ops-bot
ops-bot: runbook: traffic-steer CLI -> `ri traffic steer --service gateway --from eu-west-1 --to eu-central-1,us-east-1 --percent 100 --duration 15m` (requires 2 approvers)
priya (eng-oncall): I'll start with 50% to eu-central, 50% to us-east, duration 10m. Executing with Jon for approval.
jon (sre): approve. executing steer now.
priya (eng-oncall): `ri traffic steer --service gateway --from eu-west-1 --to eu-central-1,us-east-1 --percent 50,50 --duration 10m`
incidents-bot: ACTION: traffic steer initiated by priya (eng-oncall). Old routing gradually decreasing per policy.
sara (product): product FYI — we have a few enterprise customers pegged in eu-west. Any ETA on full mitigation?
alex (cs): I'm pinging impacted accounts now — initial reports from 3 customers showing timeouts in ingestion pipelines.
luca (sre): after partial steer, 5xx dropped to ~5% in 5m window. Latency still higher on requests that hit eu-west1.
jon (sre): digging into proxy logs: repeated upstream connection resets to inference-proxy-backend-3. Example:
```
ERROR upstream connection reset: dial tcp 10.12.34.56:9000: connection reset by peer
```
jon (sre): health checks for backend-3 show intermittent failures. I'm going to cordon that node from LB pool.
priya (eng-oncall): `ri lb drain --pool eu-west1/proxy-pool --instance inference-proxy-backend-3` — doing now.
incidents-bot: NOTE: instance inference-proxy-backend-3 moved to DRAINING state by priya (eng-oncall).
luca (sre): once drained, 5xx dropped to 1.1% and SLOs are within tolerances. Good sign.
sara (product): thanks team. any idea root cause yet?
jon (sre): hypothesis: new gateway image changed keepalive/idle timeout semantics; backends hit max concurrent connections then reset. Need to verify kernel/socket stats and proxied client settings.
priya (eng-oncall): grabbing socket stats from the backend: `ss -s` and `cat /proc/net/netstat` now.
jon (sre): also check k8s pod OOMs or unexpected restarts. `kubectl get pods -o wide -n prod | grep inference-proxy`
priya (eng-oncall): no restarts in last 30m. memory stable. socket queue shows elevated SYN_RECV.
luca (sre): can we fallback gateway to previous image for eu-west only? rollback would be faster than a config tweak.
priya (eng-oncall): rollback requires deploy approval. @mk-deploy-bot do we have a pinned previous image tag available and fast rollback option?
mk-deploy-bot: last stable image: gateway:v20250410-2350. Rollback CLI: `ri deploy rollback --service gateway --region eu-west-1 --to gateway:v20250410-2350`
jon (sre): consider canary rollback to 25% first since steer already split traffic. But priority is stability — I'd do 100% if drain and steer don't hold.
priya (eng-oncall): Ops suggests leaving steer for another 10m and then execute a full rollback if errors persist. initiating extended steer to maintain customer experience.
priya (eng-oncall): `ri traffic steer --service gateway --from eu-west-1 --to eu-central-1,us-east-1 --percent 70,30 --duration 20m`
incidents-bot: ACTION: traffic steer updated by priya (eng-oncall).
alex (cs): Customers A and B confirmed improvement after initial steer. Still getting a few spikes but less frequent. I'm keeping them updated.
sara (product): please capture affected endpoints and time ranges — we need a customer impact summary for the postmortem and communications.
priya (eng-oncall): noted. I'll export logs and request counts by route for the last 60m and drop into the incident channel after stabilization.
jon (sre): adding temporary circuit-breaker on gateway upstream -> inference-proxy: set max_conns=200, max_pending=100 for eu-west route.
luca (sre): implemented CB in config and pushed to edge config service. Should take effect within ~30s.
incidents-bot: CONFIG UPDATE: circuit-breaker applied to gateway->inference-proxy upstream in eu-west-1 by luca (sre).
priya (eng-oncall): monitoring: circuit-breaker reduced retries and prevented large backlog. error rate steady ~0.8% now.
jon (sre): ok let's prepare for handoff to next on-call in 30m. Luca can take triage and lead postmortem.
luca (sre): I can take it. I'll keep the steer in place until rollback decision but won't escalate to execs unless >5% errors persist for another 20m.
priya (eng-oncall): handing off to luca in 30m. I'm going to create an incident timeline and preliminary impact notes.
priya (eng-oncall): INCIDENT NOTES: root cause suspected: gateway image change altered keepalive/conn behavior causing connection resets on inference-proxy instance. Mitigations: traffic steer, drain bad instance, circuit-breaker, config change. Customers affected: 3 enterprise tenants with traffic routed via eu-west1. Peak error rate 18% at 09:14 UTC, sustained above 2% for ~11 minutes. Current status: degraded -> recovering. Next steps: rollback or config patch, postmortem, customer comms.
sara (product): flagging for comms team. Alex, coordinate on messages once postmortem has preliminary root cause.
alex (cs): on it. I'll prepare a short note for impacted accounts and schedule follow-ups.
priya (eng-oncall): creating incident channel #incident-eu-west-gateway-1749999000 and attaching logs.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT CHANNEL CREATED: #incident-eu-west-gateway-1749999000 by priya (eng-oncall)
priya (eng-oncall): last check: 5xx 0.6% in last 5m. Keeping steer for full 20m then reassess. handing to luca in 30m as noted.
luca (sre): acknowledged. I'll monitor and if stable will start a controlled rollback to gateway:v20250410-2350 in eu-west to remove risk.
jon (sre): thumbs for postmortem. Also add test harness for connection keepalive scenarios to catch this in future.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. Owners: luca (sre), priya (eng-oncall). Postmortem required.
priya (eng-oncall): thanks team. ending primary page. I'll follow up in the channel with exported metrics and timeline. :thumbsup:
luca (sre): taking it from here. will send a handoff summary in 25m.
alex (cs): customer update queued. thanks everyone.
mk-deploy-bot: deploy notice: rollback queued (pending manual confirm) for eu-west-1 if errors >2% after steer period.
priya (eng-oncall): last_message: monitoring continues. will attach artifacts to #incident-eu-west-gateway-1749999000."
